name: m_ex_fix_mask_types
description: [mapgen fix types_nodes#4/#3/#6, verifier round 2] Data Masking whose entries give no pc: the rule's data type comes from the field (id INTEGER -> the numeric Key rule, bigint 19/0; dob TIMESTAMP -> the date Random rule, 1970..2038), passthrough restores id / dob / email with their own types, and the target carries no poll attribute of its own (generator default 1 s). Deployed through the lint gate (no --force-lint). Target ex_fix_mask_types_out (out_email STRING, out_id INT64, out_dob TIMESTAMP, email STRING, id INT64, dob TIMESTAMP).

nodes.name: SRC_PEOPLE
nodes.query: SELECT 'Jane.Doe@example.com' AS email, 101 AS id, TIMESTAMP '1985-06-15 10:30:00' AS dob UNION ALL SELECT 'bob.roe@example.org', 102, TIMESTAMP '1999-12-31 23:59:59'
